assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are not yet public; all submitted geometry uses the repository provisional rough polygons (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false).
assumptions.impact: All area metrics (site, green, public, building, phasing, key areas) are concept values under provisional geometry and must be recalculated under EPSG:4548 when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundary released with recorded source, version and CRS.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory-plan controls (FAR, building height, building density, setbacks, road redlines, facility standards) are not present in the public task package.
assumptions.impact: floor_area_ratio, total_floor_area_sqm, building_height_m and road_area_ratio remain status=unknown with null values and reasons; no speculative value is presented as an approved indicator.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory-plan conditions or official design-brief attachments become available.

assumptions.statement: Land ownership, parcel boundaries and existing building survey data are not available.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are concept classifications only, never parcel-level conclusions; renewal projects list ownership as a dependency.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official ownership and building survey data provided.

assumptions.statement: Engineering conditions (utilities, fire, flood control, energy loads, bridge/tunnel feasibility, underground space) are not available.
assumptions.impact: No engineering feasibility conclusions are made; municipal strategies are concept skeletons requiring professional deepening.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Engineering feasibility studies by professional teams.

assumptions.statement: Heritage-protection boundaries and control zones along the Jing-Zhang railway corridor are not available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: The heritage-corridor character zone in constraints.geojson is a concept sketch (provisional_constraint), not a heritage redline; height/character controls are concept suggestions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official heritage-protection scope and control requirements confirmed.
